name: Honest Pullback Test
note: One complete signal - close crossing above EMA(20) while ADX(14) is above adx_min - and TWO entry arms selected by pb_atr. pb_atr = 0 is Arm I: act on the signal bar itself. pb_atr > 0 is Arm P: arm a limit at min(EMA20, close - pb_atr*ATR) for the next pb_bars bars and act only on the first bar whose LOW touches it; a signal no bar touches produces no trade at all, which is exactly the sample the folklore quietly deletes. Exits are identical for both arms - a 2*ATR trail off the best close since entry plus an unconditional 30-bar time stop - so the only difference between two grid cells is WHEN the entry happened. The opportunity-cost ledger the idea asks for (scoring Arm P's unfilled signals at Arm I's realised return) is a report over the two arms' trade lists, not something a signal function can emit; putting both arms in one sweep is what makes that report computable downstream.
source: Perold (1988) implementation shortfall opportunity-cost term, framework confirmed via the implementation shortfall literature; the survivorship-in-entries critique and the test design are my own synthesis.
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    ctx.em = ctx.indicator("ema", period=int(ctx.p.ema_n))
    ctx.dx = ctx.indicator("adx", period=int(ctx.p.adx_n))
    ctx.aa = ctx.indicator("atr", period=14)
    ctx.arm = None          # (direction, limit price, last bar the limit lives)


def _raw(ctx, i):
    e, pe = ctx.em[i], ctx.em[i - 1]
    c, pc = ctx.c[i], ctx.c[i - 1]
    d = ctx.dx.adx[i]
    if None in (e, pe, c, pc, d) or d < float(ctx.p.adx_min):
        return 0
    if pc <= pe and c > e:
        return 1
    if pc >= pe and c < e:
        return -1
    return 0


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < 2:
        return 0
    s = _raw(ctx, i)
    if float(ctx.p.pb_atr) <= 0.0:
        return s                       # Arm I: take the signal where it fired

    a = ctx.aa[i]
    e = ctx.em[i]
    c = ctx.c[i]
    # a fresh signal replaces whatever was resting -- one live limit at a time
    if s and a is not None and e is not None and c is not None and a > 0.0:
        depth = float(ctx.p.pb_atr) * a
        lim = min(e, c - depth) if s > 0 else max(e, c + depth)
        ctx.arm = (s, lim, i + max(1, int(ctx.p.pb_bars)))
        return 0

    if ctx.arm is None:
        return 0
    d, lim, last = ctx.arm
    if i > last:
        ctx.arm = None                 # expired unfilled -- this signal is lost
        return 0
    lo, hi = ctx.l[i], ctx.h[i]
    if lo is None or hi is None:
        return 0
    if d > 0 and lo <= lim:
        ctx.arm = None
        return 1
    if d < 0 and hi >= lim:
        ctx.arm = None
        return -1
    return 0
